description: This file is a C++ source file implementing radio configuration interface for Android's radio hardware abstraction layer (HAL). It defines classes, methods, and functions for managing radio configuration responses and indications, including handling slot status, modem configurations, and capabilities, and interacts with Android's hardware radio interfaces.
